explanation: For each prefix, remember the length of its final dictionary word if a decomposition exists. Test dictionary substrings following earlier reachable prefixes. Reconstruct a valid decomposition backward from the final prefix and reverse its word list.
timeComplexity: O(n^3) expected worst-case time including substring construction and hashing.
spaceComplexity: O(n) prefix table, plus reconstructed output strings.
